headline: Optical Stochastic Cooling Advances: New Amplifier Design and IOTA Facility Progress
deck: A recent series of studies has refined the technology behind optical stochastic cooling, introducing a Cr:ZnSe single‑pass amplifier to boost undulator radiation and detailing the design and experimental agenda of Fermilab’s Integrable Optics Test Accelerator (IOTA). Together, these developments bring the community closer to realizing high‑efficiency cooling for next‑generation accelerators.
section_order: 1. A Single-pass Cr:ZnSe Amplifier for Broadband Infrared Undulator Radiation
